description: This file defines the RefRadioConfig class, which inherits from RadioConfig and adds a method getSimultaneousCallingSupport, within the cf::ril namespace. It includes external RadioConfig definitions and is part of the radio interface layer for Android.

classes.name: RefRadioConfig
classes.description: A class extending RadioConfig with an additional method to support querying simultaneous calling support.

methods.name: getSimultaneousCallingSupport
methods.description: Method to retrieve support status for simultaneous calling, taking a serial number as input.
